name: Nekata Munetsugu
source:
The priest on the island and [url=/c10792]Rouryuu[/url]'s accomplice. A few years ago Munetsugu had to sacrifice his  oldest daughterTsunami.  After [url=/c352]Shouko[/url] found out that, he tried to kill her, but [url=/c356]Kaya[/url] prevented it in the cost of her life. 

[spoiler]He is [url=/c353]Yasumi[/url] and [url=/c354]Nami[/url]'s father.[/spoiler]
